<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>List the timeless accounts of an account.</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"get"} path={"/v1/timeless-indices"}></MethodEndpoint>



Returns the timeless accounts of the account that owns the API token in the request, with the account's timeless plan limits.

Must be run with an API token that has the **Admin** role. API tokens created before token roles were introduced have the same permissions as Admin.

Timeless accounts are created in the Logz.io app, on the [Manage accounts page](https://app.logz.io/#/dashboard/settings/manage-accounts). They can't be created through the API.

Please ensure to change the region in the URL to match your account's region.
